product_name: Duralast Elite Rear Ceramic Brake Pad Set
description: OEM-style rear ceramic brake pad set featuring a distinctive honeycomb-perforated steel backing plate for improved heat dissipation, chamfered and slotted friction material for quiet, vibration-free stopping, and a bonded wear indicator. Backed by Duralast's 3X Longer Life formulation for extended pad life over standard ceramic compounds.

product_name: Duralast Gold Heavy-Duty Front Brake Pad Set
description: Semi-metallic front brake pad set engineered for full-size trucks and SUVs, featuring a deeply curved friction surface, reinforced steel backing plates, and integrated anti-rattle clips. Includes a full hardware kit (shims and clips) for a complete installation.

product_name: Duralast Gold Semi-Metallic Front Brake Pad Set
description: OE-grade semi-metallic front brake pad set with machined slots and chamfers for smooth, quiet engagement and low dust output. Each pad includes a factory-style electronic wear-sensor wire and a galvanized steel backing plate for corrosion resistance.

product_name: Premium Ceramic Front Brake Pad Set
description: Flat, rectangular front brake pad set with beveled edges and a light grey ceramic friction compound bonded to a black-coated steel backing plate. Designed for low noise and minimal brake dust on OE-style sedans. Sold without retail packaging.

product_name: Akebono ProACT Front Performance Brake Pad Set
description: Performance-oriented front brake pad set with a split friction pad design mounted to a heavy-duty backing plate with reinforced mounting ears and abutment clips. Higher-friction ceramic-composite compound intended for SUVs carrying heavier loads.

product_name: ACDelco Professional Front Brake Pad Set with Wear Sensor
description: Curved front brake pad set with contoured mounting ears, dark grey friction material, and a factory-style wear-sensor contact point moulded into one pad. Steel backing plates feature a black e-coat finish for corrosion resistance.

product_name: Bosch Premium FILTECH Spin-On Oil Filter
description: Glossy black spin-on oil filter featuring Bosch's FILTECH multi-layer filtration media for improved contaminant capture and extended service intervals. Silver perforated base flange with eight drain-back holes and a printed Bosch Premium Oil Filter label.

Cartridge-style oil filter with a tightly pleated tan paper filtration element and a black plastic top cap fitted with two locating prongs. Sold with a fresh rubber housing seal and rated for 5,000-mile service intervals.

Compact blue spin-on oil filter in STP retail packaging, rated for 5,000-mile oil-change intervals. Steel canister with a silicone anti-drainback valve and a pre-lubricated rubber gasket for hand-tight installation.

OEM-replacement rectangular panel air filter with a pleated yellow paper media element bonded into a moulded black plastic frame. Directional FLOW arrows and a TOP marking are moulded into the frame for correct installation orientation.

Universal-fit performance cone air filter with red cross-weave cotton gauze media pleated around a black rubber base, a polished chrome inlet flange, and a stainless steel worm-drive hose clamp for a secure fit onto aftermarket intake tubing.

Round OEM-style replacement air filter featuring densely pleated yellow paper media radiating from a centre bore, sealed top and bottom with a black rubber gasket rim designed to seat inside a factory round air-cleaner housing.
Premium oval-shaped performance air filter with deep-pleated red cotton-gauze media and a moulded black rubber sealing base, embossed with PREMIUM PERFORMANCE FILTER and a part reference number.

Cabin air filter featuring alternating white pleated micro-glass media and grey activated-carbon-infused pleats within a rigid black frame, with a locating hole for tool-free removal. Filters incoming HVAC air of dust, pollen and odours.

OEM-style port fuel injector featuring a slim stainless-steel body, a black two-prong electrical connector, a precision single-hole spray nozzle at the tip, and dual colour-coded sealing O-rings for a leak-free fit in the fuel rail and intake manifold.

High-pressure gasoline direct injection injector with a compact stainless-steel body, a hex-flanged high-pressure fuel inlet fitting, and a black electrical connector. The narrow spray-tip nozzle is engineered to withstand the elevated rail pressures of direct-injection engines.

Heavy-duty common rail diesel injector featuring an elongated machined steel body, a side-mounted high-pressure banjo-style fuel return fitting, and a black electrical connector housing the internal solenoid valve.

Integrated unit injector combining a camshaft-actuated high-pressure pump and injector nozzle in one assembly. Features a large coil-spring plunger mechanism, a cast mounting flange with sealing O-rings, and a side-mounted electrical connector for solenoid control.

Dual-fuel injector rail assembly consisting of four black-bodied LPG/CNG injectors mounted on a common brushed-steel rail with two mounting ears. Each injector has its own electrical connector and a colour-coded O-ring seal at the base.

OEM hydraulic power steering pump featuring an integrated black plastic fluid reservoir mounted atop a precision-machined cast-aluminium pump housing, a multi-groove belt-driven pulley, and a side-mounted pressure outlet fitting.

Compact hydraulic power steering pump without an integrated reservoir, featuring a cast-aluminium body, an exposed multi-groove belt-driven pulley, and precision-machined hydraulic inlet and outlet ports for remote-reservoir installations.

Electro-hydraulic power steering pump combining a compact hydraulic pump with an integrated electric motor and electronic control unit. Features a black connector plug, a side-mounted fluid inlet hose barb, and a pressure outlet port for on-demand steering assist.

Electronic drive-by-wire throttle body featuring a precision-machined cast-aluminium housing, a brass-tone throttle plate visible through the bore, an integrated black electronic actuator motor, and a multi-pin electrical connector for the throttle position sensor.

Mechanical cable-operated throttle body equipped with a cast-aluminium housing, an external throttle cable pulley and return-spring linkage, and an adjustable cable-stop bracket for direct mechanical throttle response.

High-performance dual-bore CNC-machined billet-aluminium throttle body featuring two brass-tone butterfly valves linked by a common shaft, a cable-pulley throttle linkage, and a compact four-bolt mounting flange for increased airflow.

OEM-style throttle body incorporating an integrated electronic actuator motor, a multi-pin sensor connector, and two brass barbed vacuum ports for the Idle Air Control circuit, providing stable idle speed and accurate throttle position feedback.

Heavy-duty diesel air intake throttle valve assembly featuring a reinforced cast housing, an oversized black electronic actuator, dual brass port fittings, and a wide-bore intake passage engineered for industrial diesel airflow demands.

product_name: Wheel Hub Assembly with ABS Sensor
description: Front wheel hub assembly with an integrated ABS wheel speed sensor and pre-installed sealed bearing. Features a precision-machined five-stud flange, a corrosion-resistant plated finish, and a routed sensor harness terminating in a black multi-pin connector.

Wheel hub assembly without an ABS sensor, featuring a cast-iron bearing carrier, an integrated sealed double-row bearing, and a durable five-stud steel flange engineered for reliable long-term wheel support.

Compact wheel hub assembly designed for lightweight passenger vehicles, featuring a smaller-diameter flange with four wheel studs, a precision-machined steel body, and an integrated sealed bearing for smooth low-friction rotation.

Heavy-duty wheel hub assembly engineered for pickup trucks and commercial vehicles, featuring a reinforced six-stud flange, an oversized sealed double-row bearing, and an integrated rear steering-knuckle mounting flange with multiple bolt-through holes.

OEM-style cast-iron log exhaust manifold featuring four integrated header runners, a rough-cast textured finish, and a multi-hole mounting flange for a direct-fit factory replacement on inline-four engines.

Stainless steel shorty performance header with short, mandrel-bent primary tubes converging into a compact merge collector, paired with a black-coated mounting flange for improved exhaust flow over the stock cast manifold.

product_name: Performance Header with Integrated Catalytic Converter
description: Performance header with an integrated catalytic converter, featuring brushed stainless-steel primary tubes merging into a cylindrical converter canister, designed as a bolt-on emissions-compliant upgrade over the factory manifold.

Long-tube performance header featuring four individually mandrel-bent stainless-steel primary tubes merging into a single large-diameter collector with a slip-fit exhaust outlet, engineered for maximum exhaust flow in V8 applications.

product_name: OEM Exhaust Manifold with Catalytic Converter
description: OEM-style exhaust manifold and catalytic converter assembly with a weathered stainless finish, featuring integrated log-style runners, a mid-mounted catalytic converter canister, and a factory mounting flange for direct-fit replacement.

Manifold and catalytic converter assembly viewed from the flange side, showing four dark exhaust ports in a cast flange. Stainless runners merge upward into the converter body, with a side outlet pipe and welded mounting brackets.

Turbocharger mounted directly to a four-port cast exhaust manifold. The assembly includes the turbine housing, a compressor housing with machined outlet, and an electronic wastegate actuator with its wiring connector.

Compact stainless manifold with three runners merging into a cylindrical catalytic converter. A flat triangular mounting flange sits at the inlet, with a threaded oxygen sensor bung ahead of the outlet.
Matched pair of OEM-replacement front strut assemblies featuring black coil springs, precision-machined damper bodies, and silver upper strut mounts pre-installed for a direct bolt-in replacement.
Matched pair of performance shock absorbers featuring polished chrome damper bodies, red powder-coated coil springs, and dual spherical eyelet mounts for adjustable ride height applications.
Standard rear shock absorber with a chrome-plated damper body, a black coil-over spring, and rubber-bushed eyelet mounts at both ends for a direct OEM-style replacement fit.

product_name: OEM Front Strut Assembly with Knuckle
description: OEM-style front strut assembly with an integrated steering-knuckle mounting bracket, a silver damper body, and a black coil spring, engineered as a complete direct-fit replacement including the knuckle interface.

Adjustable remote-reservoir shock absorber featuring a piggyback reservoir canister connected via a braided hydraulic line, a silver damper body, and a coil-over spring, designed for high-performance and off-road applications.
Bare front strut supplied without a spring - a black damper body with an upper spring seat, protruding piston rod, welded lower mounting bracket and a brake hose clip.
Air suspension strut with a double-convoluted black rubber air bellows over a polished body, an air line fitting at the top, and a forged U-shaped lower mounting bracket.
Pair of plain twin-tube shock absorbers with matte black bodies, dust sleeves, and eyelet mounts at both ends fitted with bronze-coloured bushings. Supplied without springs.

Rubber-and-steel control arm bushing featuring a cylindrical outer steel sleeve bonded to a moulded rubber inner body with a splined centre bore, designed for OEM-style vibration isolation in the front control arm.
Rear control arm bushing featuring a cylindrical steel sleeve with moulded rubber on both faces, providing controlled flex and vibration damping at the suspension pivot point.

Performance polyurethane bushing featuring an orange polyurethane body bonded to a zinc-plated steel sleeve, engineered as a firmer, longer-lasting aftermarket replacement for factory sway bar and control arm bushings.

product_name: Front Lower Control Arm Bushing with Bracket
description: Front lower control arm bushings pre-installed in machined metal mounting brackets, featuring moulded rubber bushing cores with relief voids and an elongated bolt slot for direct bolt-in replacement. Supplied as a left and right pair.

Set of three green polyurethane subframe bushings featuring a cylindrical polyurethane body bonded to a steel inner sleeve, designed as a durable aftermarket upgrade for factory rubber subframe mounts.
Moulded rubber suspension bushing with an hourglass body and flared ends, showing a metal inner sleeve at the centre bore. Supplied as a press-in rubber component without an outer shell.
Bushing pressed into a flat black mounting bracket with a bolt hole at each end. The barrel-shaped rubber body sits between the two arms of the bracket.
Kit of three white polyurethane bushings in graduated sizes, each with a top-hat profile - a flanged base with a raised body and a central bore.
